sentences.text: No; for a floating-rate business loan to an MSE sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026, a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on loans with sanctioned amount or limit up to ₹50 lakh, and this case is ₹40 lakh.

The business-purpose floating-rate rule for individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises applies to this case because the loan is for business purpose, the borrower is an MSE, the bank is a Tier 3 UCB, and the sanction date is 1 March 2026.
The older floating-rate directions were superseded and are not the basis for this case.
